fields.name: ID
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: Object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `vector_store.file_batch`.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the vector store files batch was created.

fields.name: VectorStoreID
fields.description: The ID of the [vector store](/docs/api-reference/vector-stores/object) that the [File](/docs/api-reference/files) is attached to.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The status of the vector store files batch, which can be either `in_progress`, `completed`, `cancelled` or `failed`.
